title: Access policy evaluator: implement the version 1 specification
prompt: This is Gatekeeper, an access-policy evaluator (package accesspolicy/). docs/POLICY.md is the specification, with numbered rules R1 to R40, and docs/EXAMPLES.md has worked examples. The current code implements only part of it (see CHANGELOG.md), and some of what it does implement contradicts the specification. Make the library follow docs/POLICY.md completely: implement what is missing, fix what is wrong, keep the public API (load_policy, Evaluator.evaluate, Decision, the audit sinks) as it is, and make sure the test suite passes.
